description.en: Checks installed DSH plugins against the running host and reports each missing service or method with its file:line, a certainty of certain or suspected, and the basis for the claimed impact, plus coverage limits; adds a verdict badge and a per-plugin findings section to the plugin detail page, a compat_check agent tool and a skill provider.
description.zh: 检查已安装 DSH 插件与当前宿主是否兼容，逐条报出缺失的服务或方法及其 file:line、确定度（certain 或 suspected）与影响依据，并给出覆盖限制；在插件详情页提供结论角标与逐项发现，另有 compat_check 对话工具与 skill provider。
